ig_caption:
What is an agent harness? 🧠⚙️

A model alone can't do anything. It reads text and writes text.
The harness is everything around it:
🔁 the loop that keeps it working until the job is done
🛠 the tools it can call
🧠 memory between steps
📏 rules it must follow
🛡 permissions that stop it doing damage

Agent = model + harness. At work, this is exactly what I build.

Part 1/6 of Agent Harness 101. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
